description:
KEYSTONE for every text-processing ticket in fz-5xp.

native_codegen/receive.rs:654 handles Region::Bitstring by calling emit_bitstring_test
(receive.rs:1083) -- a complete implementation with emit_bitstring_like_guard, field
extraction, and variable-size bindings over fz_bs_reader_init_ref / fz_bs_read_field_ref.

jobs/native.rs:3092 returns an error for the SAME region:
  "native entry-dispatch lowering does not support bitstring tests yet"

So native codegen has two dispatch-region lowerings and only one is finished.

PROVEN at 67e09d373 -- the identical pattern, both positions:
  receive do <<len, payload::binary-size(len), rest::binary>> -> len end  => 3  (native OK)
  case m  do <<len, payload::binary-size(len), rest::binary>> -> len end  => native lowering failure

Extraction already works natively outside dispatch: <<a, b, rest::binary>> = s yields
{1, 2, <<3, 4>>} on the native path. Only the boolean region TEST is absent.

DONE = one region-test emitter serves both dispatch sites (fold, do not copy), and
fixtures2/00310_binary_pattern_header.fz + 00311_binary_variable_size.fz pass on run
and build, not just interp. Those two carry no frontmatter and no defer: today, and
the matrix only scans fixtures2/behavior/, so they are currently ungated on native --
move or mirror them into behavior/ so the parity gate actually covers this.

comments.text:
CORRECTION to this ticket's framing, verified before anyone starts it.

I filed this as "one region-test emitter serves both dispatch sites (fold, do not copy)". That is not accurate: the two sites are at DIFFERENT LAYERS.

  native_codegen/receive.rs:1083  emit_bitstring_test emits CRANELIFT IR directly --
                                  a FunctionBuilder, explicit basic blocks,
                                  b.ins().brif(cmp, true_b, &[], false_b, &[]).
                                  ~151 lines.
  jobs/native.rs:3093             entry dispatch emits FZ IR -- ctx.emit_let(Prim::...)
                                  returning a Var, lowered to Cranelift later.

So there is no single function both can call as written.

THE GOOD NEWS is that the primitives are already there and already used in this
very file. jobs/native.rs emits Prim::BitReaderInit, Prim::BitReadField and
Prim::BitReaderDone today -- that is how an irrefutable binding like
`<<a, b, rest :: binary>> = s` extracts natively (verified: it yields
{1, 2, <<3, 4>>} on the native door at HEAD). What is missing is using those
primitives to build a boolean TEST for clause selection, not the ability to read
a bitstring.

So the work is: express Region::Bitstring at the IR layer with the reader prims
already in use here, mirroring the SEMANTICS emit_bitstring_test implements
(the bitstring-like guard, per-field extraction, and variable-size bindings such
as `binary-size(len)`). Read that function as the specification.

Worth deciding while doing it: whether the receive path should then be re-expressed
in terms of the IR-level construction too, so the semantics stop living twice --
that is the actual fold, and it is the reason to prefer mirroring the existing
implementation over inventing a second reading of the shape.

Still verified, unchanged: identical pattern, both positions, at HEAD.
  receive do <<len, payload::binary-size(len), rest::binary>> -> len end  => 3, native OK
  case m  do <<len, payload::binary-size(len), rest::binary>> -> len end  => native lowering failure
And fixtures2/00310_binary_pattern_header.fz / 00311_binary_variable_size.fz carry no
frontmatter and no defer:, and the matrix only scans fixtures2/behavior/, so they are
currently ungated on the native door -- move or mirror them into behavior/ so the
parity gate actually covers this.

title: Fold the two native bitstring region-test emitters into one
